content: Lichess Open Database (database.lichess.org): monthly PGN dumps, zstd-compressed (~tens of GB each), public domain. ~6% of games carry Stockfish [%eval] annotations (re-analyzed with SF NNUE at 40 Mnodes) usable as training labels. CCRL and the Lichess Elite DB (database.nikonoel.fr) are curated game sources. For the chosen approach, generate own labels by running Stockfish over positions, or reuse existing [%eval] tags.
